stories.title: RDNA2 carry validation reused in AnyXboxX
stories.summary: KainanP authored the instruction implementation. akimfomin prepared the validation request and LooperSalty reviewed the PR. Lyrnc supplied an independent native RDNA2 run. The receiving PR cites the data and merged to main.
stories.scope: Source and targeted hardware checks cover the listed instructions. This does not measure downstream deployment.

credits.basis: Used and credited the Native RDNA2 test in the receiving discussion

stories.title_ru: AnyXboxX применил независимую проверку переноса RDNA2
stories.summary_ru: KainanP написал реализацию. akimfomin подготовил запрос, Lyrnc провёл аппаратную проверку, LooperSalty подписал ревью. Принимающий PR ссылается на данные и был слит.

stories.title: D16 translator fix with original author retained
stories.summary: ecox982745 authored the Reforge correction. akimfomin prepared the Continued transfer. abnalstlll-byte reviewed it and GeorgiyDemo ran an independent Apple M5 Pro comparison.
stories.scope: Continued #701 remains open. The original contribution, port and hardware check have separate attribution.

credits.basis: Compared the port and the control on Apple M5 Pro

stories.title_ru: Перенос исправления D16 с сохранением автора
stories.summary_ru: ecox982745 написал исходную правку. akimfomin подготовил перенос в Continued. abnalstlll-byte провёл ревью, GeorgiyDemo сравнил две версии на Apple M5 Pro.

stories.title: Vulkan layout optimization in a receiving fork
stories.summary: The Continued work describes coalescing equivalent Vulkan layout ranges. clquwu incorporated and credited the mechanism in Leonida Ultimate.
stories.scope: The original PR remains open. The receiving commit establishes one adoption, separate from ongoing use or unmeasured workload benefits.

credits.basis: Authored the original range coalescing work
Carried the optimization into Leonida Ultimate
Attribution and implementation are in the receiving commit

stories.summary_ru: clquwu включил объединение диапазонов с одинаковым layout и сослался на исходную работу Continued.

stories.title: FrameLab used PortBridge Test Lab for Vulkan verification
stories.summary: FrameLab opened a native cross-vendor Vulkan handoff task and linked the PortBridge Test Lab in its documentation. JoeY54 supplied two hardware results under one account.
stories.scope: The result covers standalone synthetic synchronization and image readback. It does not prove continuous usage, frame generation or super resolution.

sources.label: Maintainer review of both AMD runs

credits.basis: Opened the receiving project test request
Ran all four synthetic cases on Radeon 860M
Ran a separate setup under the same login
Documents the integration and target check
Reviewed both runs against the original criteria

stories.title_ru: FrameLab использовал Test Lab для проверки Vulkan
stories.summary_ru: FrameLab открыл отдельную задачу и добавил ссылку на Test Lab в документацию. JoeY54 выполнил два прогона на разных устройствах.

stories.title: Three contributors checked a Wave32 carry fix
stories.summary: DarkPanda69 and luckyteagirl independently tested the focused XCL patch. itsSio reported controlled NVIDIA runs on a separately pinned rebased revision.
stories.scope: The RX 6800M report checked the fix only. The original XCL issue remains open. The tested rebased revision is distinct from the current fork head.

credits.basis: Control failed and the fix passed on two GPUs
Focused check passes on a different AMD GPU

stories.summary_ru: DarkPanda69 и luckyteagirl независимо проверили точечную правку. itsSio опубликовал результаты на двух NVIDIA после переноса на новую базу.
